# Gabriel Gonzales — Full Stack Web/WordPress Developer

> Portfolio of Gabriel Gonzales, a Full Stack Web and WordPress developer in Cebu City, Philippines. He builds internal tools, AI-driven admin dashboards, offline-first POS systems, and custom WordPress sites that cut manual work.

This site is a single-page portfolio. Main sections: Hero, Tech Stack, Projects (with case studies at `/project/{id}`), Experience & Awards, Gallery & Reviews, and Contact.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gabby-dev.vercel.app/): Full portfolio — work, stack, experience, and contact
- [Sitemap](https://gabby-dev.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Index of public URLs
